### Street Address
- **227 W. Lake Street, Chicago, IL 60606**
- Source: https://www.atlasstationers.com/pages/visit-our-store

### Ownership (Independent/Family-Owned)
- **Yes — family-owned since 1939**, founded by Aloysius Schmidt and currently run by Don, Therese, Brian, and Brendan Schmidt (four generations, over 85 years). Described as "the largest stationery retailer in Chicago."
- Source: https://www.atlasstationers.com/pages/the-atlas-story

### Verified Brands (from https://www.atlasstationers.com/collections/by-brand)

- Blackwing, Pelikan, Lamy, Sailor, Pilot, Kaweco, TWSBI, Namiki, Tsuchiya, Faber-Castell, Midori, Kokuyo, Hobonichi, Leuchtturm1917, Diamine, Private Reserve, Nihon Brand, Tombow, Pentel, Uniball, Zebra, Eberhard Faber, Esterbrook, Kuretake, Mt. **Kinbor is NOT found in the verified brand list** on Atlas Stationers' site. A URL-based search for `/collections/kinbor` timed out; no Kinbor-specific collection or products were identified on the site.

3. **Furukawashiko Flake Stickers – Snow and Bird** (stickers) — https://www.atlasstationers.com/collections/all/products/furukawashiko-flake-stickers-snow-and-bird

### Vendor/Product Submission / Buying Policy
- **Unknown.** Atlas Stationers does have a "Selling to Us" page referenced via links (https://www.atlasstationers.com/pages/selling-to-us), but that page returned a 404 error when visited. No explicit vendor submission policy, wholesale buyer information, or new vendor buying policy was found on any accessible page (About, Contact, FAQ, Store, homepage). Atlas Stationers appears to be a **retailer selling stationery products** (not explicitly operating as a wholesale buyer). No evidence was found of a willingness to buy from new vendors such as Kinbor.
- Source attempted: https://www.atlasstationers.com/pages/selling-to-us (404 Not Found)

### Summary for Kinbor
- **Kinbor is not listed** as a brand carried by Atlas Stationers.
- **Street address:** 227 W. Lake Street, Chicago, IL 60606 (URL: https://www.atlasstationers.com/pages/visit-our-store)
- **Ownership:** Family-owned since 1939 (URL: https://www.atlasstationers.com/pages/the-atlas-story)
- **Categories:** Notebooks, planners, stickers, washi tape, stationery, fountain pens, pencils, art supplies, and more (URLs: https://www.atlasstationers.com/collections/all)
- **Verified brands:** 90+ brands including Blackwing, Pelikan, Sailor, Midori, Hobonichi, Furukawashiko, Hyogensha Cozyca, etc. (URL: https://www.atlasstationers.com/collections/by-brand)
- **Relevant products named:** Furukawashiko Memo Pad, Hyogensha Cozyca Washi Tape, Furukawashiko Flake Stickers (URLs above)
- **Buying policy for new vendors:** Unknown (the "Selling to Us" page returned 404; no policy accessible)
